endpoints.name: Get accessible channels
endpoints.purpose: Discover channels whose content the connector principal can access
endpoints.required_scopes: HTTP Basic auth with a Zulip user or bot API email and API key
endpoints.deletion_behavior: Archived channels are identified by is_archived; deleted channels are not documented as tombstones.

endpoints.name: Get channel messages
endpoints.purpose: Fetch a full historical page sequence for each accessible channel
endpoints.required_scopes: The authenticated principal must have content access to each requested channel
endpoints.pagination: ID-anchored ranges using anchor, include_anchor, num_before, and num_after; stop when found_newest is true
endpoints.rate_limit_notes: Zulip recommends at most 1,000 messages per request; 5,000 is the server maximum.
permission_fields: Authenticated principal's channel history and shared-history access
endpoints.deletion_behavior: Deleted messages are not documented as tombstones in full-history results; full-crawl replacement removes documents no longer returned.

endpoints.name: Get organization users
endpoints.purpose: Fetch datasource identities referenced by messages and channel memberships
endpoints.required_scopes: Returns users accessible to the authenticated principal
permission_fields: email may be an API-only placeholder when real email visibility is restricted
endpoints.deletion_behavior: is_active=false marks deactivation; is_deleted=true is available on Zulip 12.0 feature level 490 or later.

endpoints.name: Get channel subscribers
endpoints.purpose: Fetch active user IDs allowed to access each private channel
endpoints.required_scopes: The authenticated principal must be allowed to access the target channel
permission_fields: subscribers contains active subscribed user IDs
endpoints.deletion_behavior: Full-crawl membership replacement removes memberships no longer returned.
